patch.objective: Change-management best practices: purpose and scope of change, risk analysis, and a backout plan

sources.cite: CompTIA A+ Certification Exam Objectives, Core 2 (220-1202), V15, document version 4.0: Operating systems 28%, Security 28%, Software troubleshooting 23%, Operational procedures 21%
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-16 (the PDF as served from the file host a search returned). Objective 4.2 'Given a scenario, apply change management procedures': documented business processes (rollback plan, backup plan, sandbox testing, responsible staff members); change management (request forms, purpose and scope of the change, change type: standard, normal, emergency; date and time: change freeze, maintenance windows; affected systems/impact; risk analysis and risk level; change board approvals; implementation; peer review; end-user acceptance). The objectives say rollback plan where the course says backout plan.
